List

The dense one. Seven flavours fit on a screen with their ingredients readable underneath. Best if the shelf grows past twenty and you're scanning for a specific thing.

Sticker sheet

Two-up squares with the emoji large and the score as a badge in the corner. With the sticker topping on, it genuinely reads as a sheet you'd peel from — the most playful of the five, and the most fun to add to.

Bento

Your best flavour takes a double-width tile with its name at full size, the rest fill in around it. The shelf gets a focal point instead of seven equal rows — it looks composed rather than listed.

Poster

Full-width rows with album-cover proportions: big tile, big name, big score. Only three or four fit on screen, so it's browsing rather than scanning — good while the shelf is small.

Leaderboard

Groups collapse into one ranked list, best first, top three numbered in the pop colour. Leans into the fact that you already rate everything out of ten. Note the untried ones fall to the bottom rather than getting their own section.

What ships

Whatever you pick becomes the SwiftUI theme file: palette tokens, the font, and the toppings as native equivalents — the die-cut outline and offset shadow are a couple of modifiers, the sprinkle field is one Canvas view.
